description: This file defines the AuthorizationServer class, which implements OAuth2 authorization server logic, including grant type management, request validation, and response handling within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: AuthorizationServer
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 authorization server functionality, managing grant types, request validation, and token responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the authorization server with repositories, keys, and optional response type.

methods.name: setEncryptionKey
methods.description: Sets the encryption key used for securing tokens.

methods.name: enableGrantType
methods.description: Enables a specific OAuth2 grant type with optional access token TTL.

methods.name: completeAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Completes an authorization request and generates an HTTP response.

methods.name: respondToAccessTokenRequest
methods.description: Processes an access token request and returns the token response.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the response type for token responses.
